research_topic: Dynamic 4-bit Quantization for LLM Inference Optimization : Implement Dynamic NF4 Quantization with token-level importance scoring to optimize inference speed (tokens/second) and memory efficiency (peak memory usage) on MMLU (57 subject knowledge evaluation), HellaSwag (commonsense reasoning robustness), and detailed FLOPs/memory/latency measurements, compared to standard quantization baselines using 7B-13B parameter models with CUDA 11.2+ and BitsAndBytes integration, advancing the 2025 core trend of LLM efficiency through context-adaptive precision adjustment where critical reasoning steps maintain high precision while routine processing uses ultra-low precision.
